trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Tensor requires_grad=True; a view operation such as expand creates a stride-0 aliased tensor; as_strided or reshape is applied to the expanded view; gradients are computed through a differentiable operation.

bug_oracle.description: Gradients computed through as_strided or reshape applied to an expanded tensor requiring gradients differ from the expected reference gradients.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate tensor shapes, strides, and requires_grad state to produce expanded, aliased view chains involving as_strided, reshape, and expand.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create base tensors with requires_grad=True; derive expanded views with stride-0 dimensions; apply view operations with explicit shapes and strides.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject requires_grad and memory aliasing constraints; ensure at least one expanded dimension has zero stride before applying as_strided or reshape.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Build base tensor -> create expanded view -> apply as_strided or reshape -> apply differentiable operation -> backward -> inspect gradients.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare gradients from the view-based graph with reference gradients from an equivalent non-view or numerical computation; flag mismatches.
